verses.1: And Yerubal and all the people who were with him camped at Horeb. They set up their camp near Mount Moriah, in the wilderness.
verses.2: And the LORD said to Gadon, “The people who are with you have taken Midian by force. They will not be able to boast before me that their hands saved them.”
verses.3: And now, let us call out to the people, saying, “Who will be afraid and tremble when they sit down from Mount Gilboa? From among the people, there remained forty-two thousand two hundred people.”
verses.4: And the LORD said to Gadon, “The people will still be too many. They will be brought down into the waters, and I will gather them there for you. But everything that I have said to you—that one thing will go with you; everything else will not go with you.”
verses.5: And He led the people to the water. Then Jehovah said to Gadon, “All those who step into the water when the dog steps in alone, and all those who kneel on their knees to drink from it.”
verses.6: And the number of those who were thirsty was as many as three thousand per person. All the rest of the people lay down on their knees, seeking to drink from the water.
verses.7: And the LORD said to Gideon, “In three days, I will save you from your enemies. I will give Midian into your hands. Then all the people will go their separate ways.”
verses.8: And they took the people’s flocks and all their possessions, as well as every Israelite who sent someone to his own household. For three days, he would keep these things under his control.
verses.9: And in that night, Jehovah said to him, “Arise and go into the camp, for I have given you over into your hands.”
verses.10: And if you are afraid of going down, then go down. But do not let your youth be lost in the wilderness.
verses.11: And you heard what they were saying. After you became stronger, you went down into the camp. He also came down, and a young man from the group of fifty men rushed towards him.
verses.12: And Midian, Amalek, and all the descendants of Canaan will fall into the abyss. Their bodies will be scattered everywhere. There will be no end to the suffering that will occur on the surface of the sea.
verses.13: And Gideon came, and he saw a man telling his companion about a dream. He said, “Look! I have had a dream.” Then he saw a shadow of bread, with holes in it. It was in the storeroom of Midian. He went over to the tent, but it collapsed and fell down.
verses.14: And Reuven said to him, “That isn’t true. It was Boaz, son of Jehoiada, who from Israel, God handed over Midian and all its territory into his hands.”
verses.15: And when Gideon heard the number of the army and their losses, he fell to his knees. He went back to Israel’s camp and said, “Arise! For the LORD has given you the victory over Midian.”
verses.16: And he took out three of the man’s eyes. He gave them to each one, along with sticks and branches.
verses.17: And he said to them, “Do as I say, and you will do the same. Now, I am coming from the end of the camp. Do whatever I command you.”
verses.18: And I will be impaled on the cross, along with all those who are with me. You also must be impaled on the crosses around the camp. And you shall say to Jehovah and to Gideon:
verses.19: And Gadon came, along with a hundred men who were at the edge of the camp, at the head of the guards. They set up the stakes and fixed them in place. Then the traps were set up, and the traps were filled with poison.
verses.20: And the three leaders were put in their positions, and they broke the chains. They held the lances in their hands, while their right hands held the spears, ready to strike. They cried out to Jehovah and to Gideon.
verses.21: And people stood around him, all around the camp. Then the entire camp rushed forward, and they began to dance and shout.
verses.22: And three arrows were shot into them. Then Jehovah caused one man’s spear to pierce his brother and all those who were in the camp. The camp was filled with death and destruction, from the door of the tent until the mouth of the tomb.
verses.23: And an Israelite man cried out from his bed, from his chair, and from every man. They pursued him after him.
verses.24: And the magicians sent Gideon into all the rivers of Egypt, saying, “Go and gather up the waters for them, so that they can use them to fill up the pools and the river.” And every man in Egypt gathered up the water, so that they could fill up the pools and the river.
verses.25: And two servants of Midian captured Orpah and Zim’ah. They killed Orpah in a pit dug for that purpose, and Zim’ah was killed by the sword. Then they rushed back to Midian. Orpah’s head and Zim’ah’s body were brought to Gideon across the Jordan River.
